values.note: Back-in electric-only sites (20/30 amp; for vans and smaller Class C rigs under 30 ft, single vehicle) $42 summer / $35 October - mid-May; back-in sites with 50 amp and sewer but no water $55; 70-ft full-hookup pull-throughs $65 summer / $55 October - mid-May. values.note: Two restrooms with 24/7 showers in the outbuilding, two more in the main building during coworking hours; laundry $10 a load; free Wi-Fi and a fiber-internet coworking space (9 am - 6 pm) in a renovated 1945 schoolhouse. No dump station: guests can dump and fill free at a vacant pull-through (ask the office); passers-through pay $5-$20.

note: Newer RV park on the Montrose outskirts (~20 km from Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP), still being built out, with mountain views, a pond (no swimming) and a dog park; a bike path runs into town. Built for recreational campers rather than long-term housing (monthly stays by application). --Claude
summary: Operator site (2026) + Firefly: live, phone 970-235-2017 matches, rates posted. Confirmed fees $35-$65 (base = back-in electric-only site for Class C under 30 ft, $42 summer / $35 off-season), 50-amp full hookups, 70-ft pull-throughs, camp store, Wi-Fi. Added showers, laundry ($10/load), no dump station (free dump/fill for guests), year-round season (FAQ), Firefly url. Cleared the note-derived 17-site count and 14-night max (no current page states either; monthly 28-day stays are sold). Note: dropped the hookup/length/amenity/max-stay/site-count restatements.
flags: Price gate: base (back-in electric-only, for vans and Class C under 30 ft) is $42 in summer, under US$50; the full-hookup pull-through is $65 in summer. Within 20 km of Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP (gateway) in any case. No in-season Firefly quote was run (Firefly carries a reCAPTCHA; README: don't automate it), so the $42 is the posted rate.

Long-stay check: transient in character, passes. The monthly option (28-day minimum, application, background check, RV insurance, no mail) is an add-on; the operator says it 'is not intended to be a long-term housing solution'.
